title: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains 1.5.44
body_markdown:
* Fixed: Included the current branch name as context when generating commit messages.
* Fixed: Addressed an issue where re-authorization was required, but the Authorize button was not working.
* Fixed: Mitigated potential memory leaks causing the IDE to freeze.
* Fixed: Enhanced the user experience for the model selector.
* Update: Agent mode is now available in **nightly** builds. While still in development, you can test it out and provide early feedback to help improve it further.
body_html:
• Fixed: Included the current branch name as context when generating commit messages.
  • Fixed: Addressed an issue where re-authorization was required, but the Authorize button was not working.
  • Fixed: Mitigated potential memory leaks causing the IDE to freeze.
  • Fixed: Enhanced the user experience for the model selector.
  • Update: Agent mode is now available in nightly builds. While still in development, you can test it out and provide early feedback to help improve it further.
